artifact.name: reference-tokens
artifact.purpose: The single language-neutral source of the reference applications' design language (docs/ReferenceAppUX.md §2): the §2.1 semantic color roles, the §2.3 typography scale, the §2.4 spacing/radii/gutter/behavior constants, the §2.5 consumer copy (`ui_labels`), and the unified SDK error-detail strings. Every platform mirror (Compose, SwiftUI, React Native, the web playground) must reproduce these names and values; scripts/check_ux_parity.mjs is the gate.
